rows.basis: Matched projected, depth, diffuse, Hagfors, fitted-Hagfors and mixed angular models carry normalized surface measure, beam product, polarization and delay-Doppler windows through conditional results. Publisher PDF review of Sultan-Salem and Tyler 2006 independently confirms the mean-square/square-mean distinction and finite-area/energy limitations. No 5.760 GHz target RCS or coherence calibration is inferred.

Conditional pointing, noise, beam partition, ground spill and complex speckle/correlation sensitivities quantify distinct receiver observables and countercases. Real antenna pattern, Jones response and calibrated IQ remain measurement boundaries.

The frozen integration joins independently reviewed standard-based two-leg attenuation/emission to pointing, polarization, obstruction visibility, receiver noise and capture. Conditional gas-chart and half-emission sensitivity are retained; no occurrence probability or local-weather forecast is claimed.

Scalar, centroid, bounded-cell, covariance-proxy and replay alternatives are compared on fitted and held-out capture/covariance metrics, mapped to native seams and bounded with explicit illustrative cost/state calculations. No timing or production-qualification claim is made.

A compatible constructed wet/visible state jointly combines atmosphere, pointing, polarization projection, noise, timing/frequency error and receiver capture; blocked-path behavior is separated. No physical joint occurrence or outage probability is claimed.

remaining_material_boundary: No calibrated 5.760 GHz whole-disk scattering/coherence measurement or station-specific beam/noise/Jones response is in the reviewed evidence. The limited search does not prove such data are generally unavailable. A matched calibrated target-band coded capture and repeated coherent IQ/reference are the next empirical discriminators.
